decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The facing materials to be used on the extensions hereby
    approved shall not be otherwise than as shall have been
    submitted to and approved by the Council before any work on
    the site is commenced.

Condition : 2 - The development shall be constructed in strict accordance
    with the drawings hereby approved or drawings which are
    subsequently approved pursuant to conditions which are
    attached to this planning permission.

Condition : 3 - No pipes or plumbing, other than rainwater pipes, shall be
    fixed on the external face of the building.

Condition : 4 - Full details, (including samples) of the proposed
    fenestration facing North Mews shall be submitted to and
    approved by the Local Planning Authority and the replacement
    windows shall be fitted in strict accordance with the
    details thus approved.

Condition : 5 - The doors to the bin stores herein approved shall not open
    outwards over the highway.

Condition : 6 - In the development herein permitted, a three bedroom unit
    shall be provided and no other residential units shall be
    occupied until such a dwelling has been provided and ready
    for occupation.

Condition : 7 - To ensure that the Council may be satisfied with the
    external appearance of the building.

Condition : 8 - To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the
    character of the immediate area.

Condition : 9 - Because it is considered that these would seriously detract
    from the appearance of the building.

Condition : 10 - To ensure that the Council may be satisfied with the
    external appearance of the building.
Condition : 11 - To avoid hazard and obstruction to pedestrians.

Condition : 12 - In pursuance of policies HG23 in the Draft Unitary
    Development Plan.

Condition : 13 - Noise from demolition and construction work is subject to
    control under the Control of Pollution Act 1974. You are
    advised to consult the Council's Environment and Consumer
    Protection Service, Pollution Team, Camden Town Hall, Argyle
    Street, WC1H 8EQ, (tel: 020-7278 4444), or to seek prior
    approval under Section 61 if you anticipate any difficulty
    in carrying out construction other than within normal
    working hours and by means that would minimise disturbance
    to adjoining premises.

Condition : 14 - This letter does not convey an approval or consent which may
    be required under any enactment, Byelaw, Order or Regulation
    other than Section 57 of the Town and Country Planning Act
    1990 (as Amended)

Condition : 15 - The correct street number or number and name must be
    displayed permanently on the premises in accordance with
    regulations made under Section 12 of the London Building
    (Amendments) Act 1939.

Condition : 16 - The arrangements for the storage of refuse and solid waste
    may be subject to control under the Building Regulations,
    and you are advised to consult the Council's Streets
    Management, Building Control Service, Camden Town Hall,
    Argyle Street  WC1H 8EQ, (tel: 020-7974 6100).
description:
The change of use of the 1st, 2nd and 3rd floors of no 4
North Mews from office (class B1) use to residential use in
connection with the conversion, and use of 4 and 5 North
Mews as offices on ground floor and basement with 5 flats
above including the construction of a three storey infil
extension to no.5 and elevational changes to both
properties,
As shown by drawing numbers 336/ 1A; 2A; 3A; 4B; 5A; 991241;
